Name: Thermal Exchange
Description: Thermal Exchange (Ability 270 - corrected 2026-09-12, was wrongly targeting id 276 which this ROM's live name table actually assigns to Rocky Payload; verified via cfg.GetText(TextName.AbilityNames)). Grants complete immunity to burns (timing 0x7C, reusing Water Veil stock routine 0xDCE94) and boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat by 1 stage when struck by a Fire-type attack (timing 0x60 via event packet dispatch).
